shots.narration: Hi! I'm one of the four rams on this zun. I'm over three thousand years old. People call us the biggest square zun of the Shang dynasty. Long ago, I held wine for sacred ceremonies. During the war, I was hit by bombs. I was repaired, and now I'm here.
